description: Seed data: 30 diverse Indian recipes (vegetarian + non-veg, multiple cuisines) with full nutrition data

recipes.name: Poha
recipes.description: Flattened rice tempered with mustard seeds, curry leaves, peanuts, and turmeric
instructions_user: Rinse poha in water and drain. Add salt and turmeric, mix gently.
Heat oil, add mustard seeds, curry leaves, peanuts. Fry till golden.
Add chopped onion and green chilli, saute till soft.
Add poha, mix gently. Cook 2-3 minutes on low heat.
Squeeze lemon juice, garnish with coriander. Serve hot.
instructions_cook: Poha ko paani mein dho ke chaan lo. Namak aur haldi milao.
Kadhai mein tel garam karo, rai, kadi patta, moongphali daalo.
Pyaaz aur hari mirch daalo, halka bhuno.
Poha daalo, dheere se milao. 2-3 minute dhimi aag pe pakao.
Nimboo nichod ke dhaniya se sajao.

recipes.name: Masala Dosa
recipes.description: Crispy rice-lentil crepe filled with spiced potato filling, served with sambar and chutney
instructions_user: Boil potatoes, peel and mash coarsely.
Heat oil, add mustard seeds, urad dal, curry leaves.
Add onion, green chilli, ginger. Saute till golden.
Add turmeric, mashed potatoes, salt. Mix well.
Spread dosa batter on hot tawa, drizzle oil. Cook till crispy.
Place potato filling, fold and serve with sambar and chutney.
instructions_cook: Aloo ubaal ke mash karo.
Tel mein rai, urad dal, kadi patta chhokhao.
Pyaaz, mirch, adrak daalo, bhuno.
Haldi, aloo, namak milao.
Tawa garam karke dosa batter failao, tel lagao, crispy hone do.
Aloo masala bharo, fold karo.

recipes.name: Aloo Paratha
recipes.description: Whole wheat flatbread stuffed with spiced potato filling, served with curd and pickle
instructions_user: Knead atta with water and salt into smooth dough. Rest 15 min.
Boil potatoes, mash. Mix with green chilli, coriander, spices.
Make small dough balls, roll, stuff with potato mixture, seal and roll again.
Cook on hot tawa with ghee/butter till golden brown on both sides.
Serve hot with curd, pickle, and butter.
instructions_cook: Aata gundho paani aur namak se. 15 min rakhne do.
Aloo ubaal ke mash karo. Mirch, dhaniya, masale milao.
Gole bana ke roll karo, aloo bharo, band karke phir se belo.
Garam tawa pe ghee laga ke dono taraf golden hone tak sekho.
Dahi, achaar aur makhan ke saath serve karo.

recipes.name: Upma
recipes.description: Savory semolina porridge with vegetables and tempered spices
instructions_user: Dry roast semolina until fragrant. Set aside.
Heat oil, add mustard seeds, urad dal, curry leaves, cashews.
Add onion, carrot, peas. Saute 3-4 minutes.
Add water (2:1 ratio), salt. Bring to boil.
Slowly add roasted semolina, stirring continuously to avoid lumps.
Cook 3-4 minutes on low heat. Add lemon juice. Serve hot.
instructions_cook: Sooji ko sukhi kadhai mein bhuno jab tak khushbu aaye.
Tel mein rai, urad dal, kadi patta, kaju chhokhao.
Pyaaz, gajar, matar daalo. 3-4 min bhuno.
Paani daalo (sooji se dugna), namak. Ubalne do.
Dheere dheere bhuni sooji daalo, lagaatar hilaate raho.
3-4 min pakao. Nimboo nichodo.

recipes.name: Egg Bhurji
recipes.description: Indian-style spicy scrambled eggs with onion, tomato, and green chillies
instructions_user: Beat eggs with salt and pepper.
Heat oil, add cumin seeds. Add chopped onion, saute till soft.
Add green chilli, tomato. Cook till tomato is soft.
Add turmeric, chilli powder. Pour in beaten eggs.
Scramble on medium heat till eggs are cooked but still soft.
Garnish with coriander. Serve with toast or pav.
instructions_cook: Ande phenko namak mirch ke saath.
Tel mein jeera, pyaaz bhuno.
Mirch, tamatar daalo, pakao jab tak naram ho.
Haldi, mirch daalo. Ande daalo.
Ande ko bhuno jab tak pak jaaye par soft rahe.
Dhaniya se sajao.

recipes.name: Rajma Chawal
recipes.description: Kidney bean curry in rich tomato gravy served over steamed basmati rice
instructions_user: Soak rajma overnight. Pressure cook with salt till soft (5-6 whistles).
Heat oil, add cumin seeds. Add onions, cook till golden.
Add ginger-garlic paste, cook 1 minute.
Add pureed tomatoes, turmeric, chilli powder, coriander powder. Cook 8-10 min.
Add cooked rajma with water. Simmer 15-20 min till thick.
Mash a few beans for thickness. Add garam masala.
Serve over steamed basmati rice, garnish with coriander.
instructions_cook: Rajma raat bhar bhigo ke pressure cooker mein 5-6 seeti do.
Tel mein jeera, pyaaz bhuno golden hone tak.
Adrak-lahsun paste daalo, 1 min pakao.
Tamatar pees ke daalo, haldi, mirch, dhaniya powder. 8-10 min pakao.
Rajma paani ke saath daalo. 15-20 min dheemi aag pe pakao.
Kuch rajma maslo gaadha karne ke liye. Garam masala daalo.
Chawal ke upar serve karo.

recipes.name: Chole Bhature
recipes.description: Spicy chickpea curry with deep-fried puffed bread
instructions_user: Soak chickpeas overnight. Boil with tea bags for dark color. Drain.
Knead maida with curd, oil, salt into soft dough. Rest 2 hours.
For chole: saute onions, add ginger-garlic paste, tomato puree.
Add chole masala, turmeric, chilli powder. Cook 5 min.
Add boiled chickpeas with some water. Simmer 20 min.
Roll bhature, deep fry till puffed and golden.
Serve hot with pickled onion and green chutney.
instructions_cook: Chane raat bhar bhigo ke tea bag ke saath ubalo.
Maida ko dahi, tel, namak se gundho. 2 ghante rakhne do.
Pyaaz bhuno, adrak-lahsun, tamatar daalo.
Chole masala, haldi, mirch daalo. 5 min pakao.
Ubale chane paani ke saath daalo. 20 min pakao.
Bhature belo aur deep fry karo jab tak phoole.
Garam garam serve karo.

recipes.name: Sambar Rice
recipes.description: Tangy lentil-vegetable stew served over steamed rice
instructions_user: Cook toor dal in pressure cooker till soft (3-4 whistles).
Soak tamarind in warm water, extract pulp.
Cut vegetables into pieces. Boil till tender.
Add cooked dal, tamarind water, sambar powder, salt.
Temper with mustard seeds, curry leaves, hing in oil.
Pour tempering into sambar. Simmer 10 min.
Serve over steamed rice.
instructions_cook: Toor dal ko cooker mein 3-4 seeti do.
Imli ko garam paani mein bhigo ke ras nikalo.
Sabziyan kaat ke ubalo.
Dal, imli ka paani, sambar powder, namak daalo.
Rai, kadi patta, hing ka tadka lagao.
Tadka sambar mein daalo. 10 min pakao.
Chawal ke saath serve karo.

recipes.name: Paneer Butter Masala
recipes.description: Cottage cheese cubes in rich, creamy tomato-butter gravy
instructions_user: Blanch tomatoes and cashews. Blend into smooth paste.
Heat butter, add paste. Cook 10-12 min till oil separates.
Add kasuri methi, garam masala, chilli powder, sugar.
Add cubed paneer, cream. Simmer 5 minutes.
Garnish with cream and coriander. Serve with naan.
instructions_cook: Tamatar aur kaju ko ubaal ke pees lo.
Makhan mein paste daalo. 10-12 min pakao jab tak tel chhode.
Kasuri methi, garam masala, mirch, cheeni daalo.
Paneer ke tukde aur cream daalo. 5 min pakao.
Cream aur dhaniya se sajao. Naan ke saath do.

recipes.name: Chicken Biryani
recipes.description: Fragrant layered rice with marinated chicken, saffron, and fried onions
instructions_user: Marinate chicken with curd, ginger-garlic paste, biryani masala, chilli. Rest 1 hour.
Soak rice 30 min. Par-boil with whole spices till 70% done.
Deep fry sliced onions till dark golden (birista).
Layer: marinated chicken, then rice, then birista, mint, saffron milk.
Seal pot with dough. Cook on dum (low heat) 25-30 min.
Open, gently mix. Serve with raita.
instructions_cook: Chicken ko dahi, adrak-lahsun, biryani masala mein 1 ghanta marinate karo.
Chawal bhigo ke whole masale ke saath 70% ubalo.
Pyaaz ko barfee kaat ke deep fry karo golden hone tak.
Layer lagao: chicken, chawal, birista, pudina, kesar wala doodh.
Bartan ko aate se seal karo. 25-30 min dum pe pakao.
Kholo, dheere se milao. Raita ke saath do.

recipes.name: Dal Tadka
recipes.description: Yellow lentils tempered with cumin, garlic, and dried red chillies
instructions_user: Wash dal and pressure cook with turmeric, salt, and water (3 whistles).
Mash dal well. Add chopped tomato, cook 5 min.
For tadka: heat ghee, add cumin, garlic, dried red chillies.
Add hing, pour sizzling tadka over dal.
Squeeze lemon, garnish with coriander.
Serve with steamed rice or roti.
instructions_cook: Dal dho ke cooker mein haldi, namak, paani ke saath 3 seeti do.
Dal mash karo. Tamatar daalo, 5 min pakao.
Tadke ke liye: ghee mein jeera, lehsun, sabut lal mirch daalo.
Hing daalo, chhinchhinata tadka dal pe daalo.
Nimboo nichodo, dhaniya se sajao.
Chawal ya roti ke saath do.

recipes.name: Veg Pulao
recipes.description: Fragrant basmati rice cooked with mixed vegetables and whole spices
instructions_user: Soak rice for 30 min. Drain.
Heat ghee, add whole spices (bay leaf, cloves, cardamom, cinnamon).
Add sliced onion, cook till light golden.
Add mixed vegetables, cook 2-3 min.
Add rice, salt, mint. Add water (1.5:1 ratio).
Cover and cook on low heat till rice is done.
Serve with raita.
instructions_cook: Chawal 30 min bhigo ke chaan lo.
Ghee mein tej patta, laung, elaichi, dalchini daalo.
Pyaaz bhuno halka golden hone tak.
Sabziyan daalo, 2-3 min bhuno.
Chawal, namak, pudina daalo. Paani daalo (1.5 guna).
Dhak ke dheemi aag pe pakao jab tak chawal ho jaaye.
Raita ke saath serve karo.

recipes.name: Fish Curry (Goan)
recipes.description: Tangy coconut-based fish curry with kokum and Goan spices
instructions_user: Clean and cut fish. Marinate with salt and turmeric.
Grind coconut, coriander seeds, chillies, tamarind into paste.
Heat oil, add onion, cook till soft.
Add ground paste, tomato. Cook 5 min.
Add coconut milk, kokum, water. Bring to simmer.
Add fish gently. Cook 8-10 min without stirring much.
Serve with steamed rice.
instructions_cook: Machli saaf karke namak haldi lagao.
Nariyal, dhaniya, mirch, imli ko pees lo.
Tel mein pyaaz bhuno.
Pisa masala, tamatar daalo. 5 min pakao.
Nariyal ka doodh, kokum, paani daalo. Ubalne do.
Machli dheere se daalo. 8-10 min pakao, zyada hilao mat.
Chawal ke saath do.

recipes.name: Mediterranean Quinoa Bowl
recipes.description: Quinoa bowl with hummus, roasted vegetables, feta, and tahini dressing
instructions_user: Cook quinoa in salted water (2:1 ratio) for 15 min. Fluff with fork.
Roast chickpeas with olive oil, cumin, paprika at 200C for 20 min.
Dice cucumber and halve cherry tomatoes.
Make tahini dressing: tahini, lemon juice, garlic, water, salt.
Assemble bowls: quinoa base, roasted chickpeas, veggies, feta.
Drizzle tahini dressing and serve.
instructions_cook: Quinoa ko namkeen paani mein 15 min pakao.
Chickpeas ko olive oil, jeera, paprika ke saath oven mein 20 min roast karo.
Kheera kaat lo, tamatar aadhe karo.
Tahini dressing banao: tahini, nimboo, lehsun, paani, namak.
Bowl mein quinoa, roasted chickpeas, sabzi, feta sajao.
Dressing daal ke serve karo.

recipes.name: Tofu Stir Fry with Noodles
recipes.description: Crispy tofu with stir-fried vegetables and soy-ginger noodles
instructions_user: Press tofu, cube it. Pan-fry till golden and crispy.
Cook noodles as per package. Drain and toss with sesame oil.
Stir-fry sliced bell pepper, broccoli, carrot in hot wok.
Add ginger, garlic. Toss 1 min.
Add soy sauce, chilli sauce, vinegar. Add noodles and tofu.
Toss everything together. Serve hot.
instructions_cook: Tofu daba ke paani nikalo, tukde karo. Pan mein crispy bhuno.
Noodles ubaal ke sesame oil mein milao.
Shimla mirch, broccoli kadhai mein tez aag pe bhuno.
Adrak, lehsun daalo. 1 min bhuno.
Soy sauce, chilli sauce, vinegar daalo. Noodles aur tofu milao.
Sab achhe se milao. Garam serve karo.

recipes.name: Palak Paneer
recipes.description: Cottage cheese cubes in a smooth, creamy spinach gravy
instructions_user: Blanch spinach in boiling water 2 min. Transfer to ice water. Blend smooth.
Heat oil, add cumin seeds, onion. Cook till golden.
Add ginger-garlic paste, tomato. Cook till soft.
Add spinach puree, salt, garam masala. Simmer 5 min.
Add paneer cubes and cream. Cook 3-4 min.
Serve with roti or naan.
instructions_cook: Palak ko 2 min ubaal ke thande paani mein daalo. Pees lo.
Tel mein jeera, pyaaz bhuno golden hone tak.
Adrak-lahsun, tamatar daalo. Naram hone tak pakao.
Palak puree, namak, garam masala daalo. 5 min pakao.
Paneer ke tukde aur cream daalo. 3-4 min pakao.
Roti ya naan ke saath do.

recipes.name: Moong Dal Khichdi
recipes.description: Comforting one-pot rice and lentil dish with ghee and papad
instructions_user: Wash rice and moong dal together.
Pressure cook with turmeric, salt, water (3:1 ratio) for 3 whistles.
Heat ghee, add cumin seeds, hing, dried red chilli.
Pour tadka over khichdi. Mix gently.
Roast or fry papad.
Serve khichdi with ghee on top, curd, papad, and pickle.
instructions_cook: Chawal aur moong dal dho lo.
Cooker mein haldi, namak, paani (3 guna) ke saath 3 seeti do.
Ghee mein jeera, hing, sabut lal mirch ka tadka lagao.
Tadka khichdi pe daalo. Dheere se milao.
Papad bhuno ya talo.
Ghee, dahi, papad, achaar ke saath serve karo.

recipes.name: Butter Chicken
recipes.description: Tender chicken in a rich, buttery tomato-cream sauce
instructions_user: Marinate chicken with yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, chilli, salt. Rest 1 hour.
Grill or pan-fry marinated chicken till charred. Set aside.
Blanch tomatoes and cashews. Blend smooth.
Melt butter, add paste. Cook 15 min till oil separates.
Add kasuri methi, garam masala, sugar, salt.
Add chicken, cream. Simmer 10 min.
Serve with butter naan.
instructions_cook: Chicken ko dahi, adrak-lahsun, mirch, namak mein 1 ghanta marinate karo.
Marinated chicken ko grill ya pan mein bhuno.
Tamatar aur kaju ubaal ke pees lo.
Makhan mein paste daalo. 15 min pakao.
Kasuri methi, garam masala, cheeni, namak daalo.
Chicken, cream daalo. 10 min pakao.
Butter naan ke saath do.

recipes.name: Baingan Bharta
recipes.description: Smoky roasted eggplant mash cooked with onions, tomatoes, and spices
instructions_user: Roast whole brinjal on direct flame till charred and soft.
Peel skin, mash the flesh.
Heat oil, add cumin seeds, chopped onion. Cook till golden.
Add green chilli, tomato. Cook till mushy.
Add mashed brinjal, salt, chilli powder, coriander powder.
Cook 8-10 min. Garnish with coriander. Serve with roti.
instructions_cook: Baingan ko seedhi aag pe bhuno jab tak jal jaaye aur naram ho.
Chhilka utaar ke mash karo.
Tel mein jeera, pyaaz bhuno golden hone tak.
Hari mirch, tamatar daalo. Gal ne tak pakao.
Mashed baingan, namak, mirch, dhaniya powder daalo.
8-10 min pakao. Dhaniya se sajao. Roti ke saath do.

recipes.name: Vegetable Thai Green Curry
recipes.description: Mixed vegetables in fragrant Thai green curry coconut sauce with jasmine rice
instructions_user: Cook jasmine rice as per package instructions.
Heat oil in wok. Add green curry paste, fry 1 min.
Add coconut milk (half). Cook till slightly reduced.
Add cubed tofu, sliced bell pepper, baby corn.
Add remaining coconut milk, soy sauce, sugar, basil.
Simmer 10 min. Serve over jasmine rice.
instructions_cook: Chawal pakao.
Kadhai mein tel garam karo. Green curry paste 1 min bhuno.
Aadha nariyal doodh daalo. Thoda gaadhaa hone do.
Tofu, shimla mirch, baby corn daalo.
Baaki nariyal doodh, soy sauce, cheeni, basil daalo.
10 min pakao. Chawal pe serve karo.

recipes.name: Chicken Tikka
recipes.description: Yogurt-marinated chicken pieces grilled till charred and smoky
instructions_user: Cut chicken into tikka-sized pieces.
Marinate with curd, ginger-garlic paste, tikka masala, lemon juice, oil, salt. Rest 2 hrs.
Thread onto skewers with bell pepper and onion chunks.
Grill or bake at 220C for 15-20 min, turning once.
Squeeze lemon. Serve with mint chutney, onion rings, green salad.
instructions_cook: Chicken ke tukde karo.
Dahi, adrak-lahsun, tikka masala, nimboo, tel, namak mein 2 ghante marinate karo.
Seekh pe lagao shimla mirch aur pyaaz ke saath.
Grill ya oven mein 220C pe 15-20 min pakao, palat ke.
Nimboo nichodo. Chutney, pyaaz ke saath do.

recipes.name: Methi Thepla
recipes.description: Fenugreek-spiced flatbread from Gujarat, perfect for travel or breakfast
instructions_user: Wash and finely chop methi leaves.
Mix wheat flour, methi, curd, turmeric, chilli, jaggery, salt, oil.
Knead into soft dough with water. Rest 15 min.
Roll into thin rounds.
Cook on tawa with oil till golden spots on both sides.
Serve with curd and pickle.
instructions_cook: Methi dho ke bareek kaato.
Aata, methi, dahi, haldi, mirch, gur, namak, tel milao.
Paani se naram aata gundho. 15 min rakhne do.
Patli roti belo.
Tawa pe tel laga ke dono taraf golden hone tak sekho.
Dahi aur achaar ke saath do.

recipes.name: Idli Sambar
recipes.description: Steamed rice-lentil cakes served with sambar and coconut chutney
instructions_user: Grease idli moulds. Pour batter. Steam 10-12 min.
For sambar: cook toor dal. Add tamarind water, vegetables, sambar powder.
Temper with mustard seeds, curry leaves, hing.
For chutney: grind coconut, green chilli, ginger with water.
Serve idlis with hot sambar and coconut chutney.
instructions_cook: Idli saanche mein tel lagao. Batter daalo. 10-12 min steam karo.
Sambar ke liye: dal pakao. Imli ka paani, sabzi, sambar powder daalo.
Rai, kadi patta, hing ka tadka lagao.
Chutney ke liye: nariyal, mirch, adrak pees lo.
Garam sambar aur chutney ke saath idli do.

recipes.name: Kadai Paneer
recipes.description: Paneer cooked with bell peppers in a spicy kadai masala gravy
instructions_user: Dry roast coriander seeds and dried red chillies. Coarsely grind (kadai masala).
Puree tomatoes. Cook in oil till thick and oil separates.
Add kadai masala, salt, turmeric. Cook 2 min.
Add cubed paneer and bell pepper strips.
Cook 5-7 min on medium heat.
Garnish with coriander and ginger juliennes. Serve with roti.
instructions_cook: Dhaniya aur sabut lal mirch sukhi kadhai mein bhuno. Mota pees lo.
Tamatar pees ke tel mein pakao jab tak gaadha ho.
Kadai masala, namak, haldi daalo. 2 min pakao.
Paneer tukde aur shimla mirch ki strips daalo.
5-7 min madhyam aag pe pakao.
Dhaniya aur adrak ke patli strips se sajao. Roti ke saath do.

recipes.name: Egg Curry
recipes.description: Hard-boiled eggs in a rich onion-tomato gravy with Bengali spices
instructions_user: Hard boil eggs. Peel and make small cuts on surface.
Fry eggs lightly till golden. Set aside.
Heat oil, add onion paste. Cook till golden brown.
Add ginger-garlic paste, tomato puree. Cook 8 min.
Add turmeric, chilli, cumin powder, salt. Add water.
Add eggs. Simmer 10 min till gravy thickens.
Garnish with coriander. Serve with rice.
instructions_cook: Ande ubaal ke chheel lo. Halke cuts lagao.
Ande halka bhuno golden hone tak.
Tel mein pyaaz ka paste bhuno golden hone tak.
Adrak-lahsun, tamatar puree daalo. 8 min pakao.
Haldi, mirch, jeera powder, namak daalo. Paani daalo.
Ande daalo. 10 min pakao gravy gaadhi hone tak.
Dhaniya se sajao. Chawal ke saath do.

recipes.name: Curd Rice
recipes.description: Cool, creamy rice mixed with tempered curd -- perfect summer dinner
instructions_user: Mash cooked rice slightly while warm. Add milk, mix well.
Let it cool. Add curd, salt. Mix gently.
Heat oil, add mustard seeds, urad dal, curry leaves, green chilli, ginger.
Pour tempering over curd rice.
Add diced cucumber, pomegranate, grapes.
Serve cold or at room temperature.
instructions_cook: Pake chawal ko garam mein thoda mash karo. Doodh milao.
Thanda hone do. Dahi, namak milao.
Tel mein rai, urad dal, kadi patta, mirch, adrak ka tadka lagao.
Tadka dahi chawal pe daalo.
Kheera, anaar, angoor daalo.
Thanda ya normal temperature pe serve karo.

recipes.name: Keema Matar
recipes.description: Minced meat cooked with green peas in aromatic spices
instructions_user: Heat oil, add cumin seeds, bay leaf, whole spices.
Add onion, cook till golden. Add ginger-garlic paste.
Add keema. Cook on high heat, breaking lumps, till browned.
Add tomato puree, turmeric, chilli, coriander powder. Cook 5 min.
Add green peas, water. Cover and cook 15 min.
Add garam masala, garnish with coriander. Serve with roti.
instructions_cook: Tel mein jeera, tej patta, sabut masale daalo.
Pyaaz bhuno golden hone tak. Adrak-lahsun daalo.
Keema daalo. Tez aag pe bhuno, guthliyan todo, brown hone do.
Tamatar, haldi, mirch, dhaniya powder daalo. 5 min pakao.
Matar, paani daalo. Dhak ke 15 min pakao.
Garam masala daalo, dhaniya se sajao. Roti ke saath do.

recipes.name: Pesarattu
recipes.description: Andhra-style green moong dal dosa, high in protein
instructions_user: Soak moong dal and rice for 4-5 hours.
Grind with ginger, green chillies, salt to a smooth batter.
Heat tawa, pour batter, spread thin like dosa.
Sprinkle chopped onion, press lightly.
Drizzle oil, cook till crispy on bottom. Fold.
Serve with ginger chutney or upma.
instructions_cook: Moong dal aur chawal 4-5 ghante bhigo do.
Adrak, mirch, namak ke saath pees lo.
Tawa garam karo, batter failao dosa jaisa.
Kati pyaaz chhidko, halka daba do.
Tel lagao, neeche se crispy hone do. Fold karo.
Adrak chutney ke saath do.

recipes.name: Vegetable Biryani
recipes.description: Layered fragrant basmati rice with mixed vegetables, saffron and fried onions
instructions_user: Soak rice 30 min. Par-boil with whole spices.
Fry sliced onions till crispy and golden.
Marinate vegetables with curd, biryani masala, chilli. Cook partially.
Layer: veggies, then rice, then birista, mint, saffron milk.
Seal and cook on dum 20-25 min.
Serve with raita.
instructions_cook: Chawal 30 min bhigo ke masale ke saath 70% ubalo.
Pyaaz ko barfee kaat ke golden brown talo.
Sabziyon ko dahi, biryani masala mein bhuno.
Layer lagao: sabzi, chawal, birista, pudina, kesar doodh.
Seal karke dum pe 20-25 min pakao.
Raita ke saath do.

recipes.name: Dal Makhani
recipes.description: Slow-cooked black lentils in buttery, creamy tomato gravy
instructions_user: Soak urad dal and rajma overnight. Pressure cook 6-7 whistles.
Melt butter, add cumin, ginger-garlic paste.
Add tomato puree, chilli powder, salt. Cook 10 min.
Add cooked dal. Simmer on very low heat 25-30 min, stirring often.
Add cream, butter, garam masala, kasuri methi.
The longer it simmers, the better it tastes. Serve with naan.
instructions_cook: Urad dal aur rajma raat bhar bhigo ke 6-7 seeti pressure cook karo.
Makhan mein jeera, adrak-lahsun bhuno.
Tamatar puree, mirch, namak daalo. 10 min pakao.
Pakki dal daalo. Bahut dheemi aag pe 25-30 min pakao, hilate raho.
Cream, makhan, garam masala, kasuri methi daalo.
Jitna dheere pakao utna achha. Naan ke saath do.

recipes.name: Ragi Dosa
recipes.description: Nutritious finger millet dosa -- high in calcium and iron
instructions_user: Mix ragi flour, rice flour, finely chopped onion, cumin, green chilli, salt.
Add water to make thin batter (thinner than regular dosa batter).
Heat tawa. Pour batter, spread quickly in circular motion.
Drizzle oil around edges. Cook till bottom is crispy.
Fold and serve with coconut chutney.
instructions_cook: Ragi aata, chawal ka aata, pyaaz, jeera, mirch, namak milao.
Paani daal ke patla batter banao.
Tawa garam karo. Batter failao gol gol.
Kinaron pe tel lagao. Neeche se crispy hone do.
Fold karo. Nariyal chutney ke saath do.
